rust_summary: a slime or magma cube splitting on death, cancellable (`native_mob_split`).
doc_summary: a slime or magma cube about to split into smaller ones on death, as NeoForge's `MobSplitEvent`: `native_mob_split(parent, kind, size, child_size, count, cancel)` runs on the server for a parent above size 1 after vanilla drew the child count. A mod may change `count` (0 to 64) or set `cancel` to spawn no children. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mob_split@.
